people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

translations.web: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”
translations.bsb: One day Acsah came to Othniel and urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What do you desire?”

translations.asv: And it came to pass, when she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she alighted from off her ass; and Caleb said, What wouldest thou?
